messages.subject: Winter Quarter Meetings: Tuesday 3 - 5, Wickson 2124
parts:
Hi all,

The winner for this quarter's meeting time is Tuesday afternoons 3 - 5, and we will be in Wickson 2124.

More to come on talks soon. As always, if there is anything you'd like to see or give a talk on, let me know.

Cheers,

Michael
